title: Compiled corpus manifest
description: generated/corpus/manifest.json, written by npm run build:corpus. Paths are repo-relative POSIX paths; the manifest holds no timestamps, so identical inputs give identical bytes.

format_version.description: Bumped on any breaking change to the bundle layout or this manifest.

input_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 over every input path and its bytes, in path order.

inputs.description: Canonical YAML input path to the SHA-256 of its bytes.

sources.description: Source documents from source/manifest.yaml, by id and file hash.

bundles.description: Bundle file name to its record count and the SHA-256 of its bytes. Each record-class bundle is {records, files}: the records as authored, and record key (id; form for aliases; pdf_page for pages) to source YAML path. graph.json is the derived dependency graph {categories, nodes, edges}; its record count is nodes plus edges.

excluded.description: Checked-in review evidence that is deliberately not compiled.
